<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_CustomPrint"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/custom-3d-print">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_CustomPrint">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Artist" name="Artist"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Instruct" name="Instruction" sourceRef="SendTask_Instruct" targetRef="Participant_Artist"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Sketches" name="Sketches" sourceRef="SendTask_Sketches" targetRef="Participant_Artist"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Draft" name="Model draft" sourceRef="Participant_Artist" targetRef="ReceiveTask_Draft"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Changes" name="Requested changes" sourceRef="SendTask_Changes" targetRef="Participant_Artist"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_STL" name="STL file" sourceRef="Participant_Artist" targetRef="ReceiveTask_STL"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Instruct an artist to create a 3D model and print it" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_1" name="Model wanted"/>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_Instruct" name="Instruct artist to create project"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_Sketches" name="Send sketches to artist"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="ReceiveTask_Draft" name="Receive model draft from artist"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Review" name="Review model draft"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Satisfied" name="Result satisfied?" default="Flow_NotSatisfied"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_Changes" name="Tell artist what to change"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="ReceiveTask_STL" name="Receive STL file from artist"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ChooseColor" name="Choose plastic color"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InStock" name="Color in stock?" default="Flow_NotInStock"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckAmount" name="Check remaining plastic amount"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Amount" name="Less than 100 g left?" default="Flow_NotLow"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ShoppingList" name="Add plastic to shopping list"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OrderPlastic" name="Order plastic color"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_StockMerge" name="Plastic available"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelSplit" name="Start printer preparation and gcode generation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrinterHeat" name="Turn on printer and heat bed and extruder"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Gcode" name="Generate gcode file from STL"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelJoin" name="Printer ready and gcode generated"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_Print" name="Print model"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_1" name="3D model printed"/>

    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="TextAnnotation_Status">
      <bpmn:text>Printer continuously sends its status back</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_Status" sourceRef="Task_PrinterHeat" targetRef="TextAnnotation_Status"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_1" targetRef="SendTask_Instruct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="SendTask_Instruct" targetRef="SendTask_Sketches"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="SendTask_Sketches" targetRef="ReceiveTask_Draft"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="ReceiveTask_Draft" targetRef="Task_Review"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Task_Review" targetRef="Gateway_Satisfied"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Satisfied" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Satisfied" targetRef="ReceiveTask_STL">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${satisfied}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotSatisfied" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Satisfied" targetRef="SendTask_Changes"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Changes" sourceRef="SendTask_Changes" targetRef="ReceiveTask_Draft"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="ReceiveTask_STL" targetRef="Task_ChooseColor"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Task_ChooseColor" targetRef="Gateway_InStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InStock" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_InStock" targetRef="Task_CheckAmount">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${inStock}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotInStock" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_InStock" targetRef="Task_OrderPlastic"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="Task_CheckAmount" targetRef="Gateway_Amount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Low" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Amount" targetRef="Task_ShoppingList">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${amountBelow100g}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotLow" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Amount" targetRef="Gateway_StockMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" sourceRef="Task_ShoppingList" targetRef="Gateway_StockMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_OrderPlastic" targetRef="Gateway_StockMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Gateway_StockMerge" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_PrinterHeat"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_Gcode"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Task_PrinterHeat" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Task_Gcode" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin" targetRef="Task_Print"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Task_Print" targetRef="EndEvent_1"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
